data.title: Feelings — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: feelings
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Feel the sun on your skin.

[Hook]
Happy… Contento
Sad… Triste
Let's sing… Cantemos
Under the sun… Bajo el sol
Come feel the waves again.

[Verse]
Sun's shining bright, not a cloud in sight,
Walking on the sand, feeling so right.
Agitated… Agitado
When the waves crash hard.
Optimistic… Optimista
Dreaming of the stars.

Surprised… Sorprendido
By the ocean's roar.
Anxious… Ansioso
For the day to explore.
Irritated… Molesto
When the seagulls steal my fries.
Pleased… Complacido
With the blue of the skies.

[Hook]
Happy… Contento
Sad… Triste
Let's sing… Cantemos
Under the sun… Bajo el sol
Come feel the waves again.

[Verse]
Desperate… Desesperado
For the sun to stay.
Scared… Asustado
Of the night and the gray.
Bored… Aburrido
When the tide's too low.
But then I see you, and my heart starts to glow.

[Bridge]
Feelings come and go, like the tide,
With you by my side, I feel alive.
Let's dance in the sand, hand in hand,
Under the sun, in this beautiful land.

[Hook]
